final: WITH ct AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS t FROM Invoice WHERE Total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CustomerId), g AS (SELECT SUM(t) AS overall FROM ct), sh AS (SELECT ct.CustomerId, ct.t, ct.t * 1.0 / g.overall AS share FROM ct, g WHERE g.overall IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT sh.t, sh.share FROM sh, a WHERE sh.share > a.avg_share) SELECT AVG(t) AS avg_customer_total, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_share_minus_avg FROM k
